policy: Original designer, designation/model and variant, then optional US nickname; British model names retain their Mark. No licensee suffix; keep compact designer abbreviations and families. Aces untouched.
onlyFamilyMoves: Li-2 after C-47 family under Douglas

earlyLateReview.G-55: Guide_409m p12: both Serie I; Late lifts the engine limitation, not a new Serie. Add Serie I and retain Early/Late.
earlyLateReview.G-55-Late: Guide_409m p12: both Serie I; Late lifts the engine limitation, not a new Serie. Add Serie I and retain Early/Late.
earlyLateReview.DXXI_SARJA3_EARLY: Guide_409m pp13-14: both Sarja 3; Late has self-sealing tank and improved armoured seat. Do not rename to Sarja 4.
earlyLateReview.DXXI_SARJA3_LATE: Guide_409m pp13-14: both Sarja 3; Late has self-sealing tank and improved armoured seat. Do not rename to Sarja 4.
earlyLateReview.Il-2_1940_Early: Local AAA labels already distinguish Series 1/2/3. Retain, not a new archival certification of Soviet serial batches.
earlyLateReview.Il-2_1940_Late: Local AAA labels already distinguish Series 1/2/3. Retain, not a new archival certification of Soviet serial batches.
earlyLateReview.Il-2_1941_Early: Local AAA labels already distinguish Series 1/2/3. Retain, not a new archival certification of Soviet serial batches.
earlyLateReview.Il-2_1941_Late: Local AAA and Aircraft Guide identify field modification, not Series 4. Preserve description and year.
earlyLateReview.Il-2M_Early: Local AAA and Aircraft Guide distinguish first/later series; no exact new numbered series established.
earlyLateReview.Il-2M_Late: Local AAA and Aircraft Guide distinguish first/later series; no exact new numbered series established.
earlyLateReview.F6F-3: AAA and Aircraft Guide pp36-37 explicitly say F6F-3 Late. No numbered production block established; not F6F-5.
earlyLateReview.P-38L_Late: Aircraft Guide pp127-130 retains P-38L Late with different quoted power. It does not identify L-1 versus L-5; retain Late.
earlyLateReview.P-47D: AAA labels P-47D-27-Late, distinct from P-47D-27. Aircraft Guide also has a separate P-47D. No proof of another block; retain D-27 Late as inherited mod label.
earlyLateReview.HurricaneMkIearly: Local OS1.1 and community names remain Mk.I. M4T describes fabric-wing/two-blade early fit but supplies no new official Mark for these exact classes.
earlyLateReview.HurricaneMkILate: Local OS1.1 and community names remain Mk.I. M4T describes fabric-wing/two-blade early fit but supplies no new official Mark for these exact classes.
earlyLateReview.TyphoonMkIBLate: Local OS1.1 and M4T 2009 explicitly identify Mk.IB Late; no different official Mark established for this class.
earlyLateReview.Fw-190D-9_Late: Local labels already distinguish 1944/1945 under D-9; retain year and weapon-mod distinction, no invented D-10 subtype.
earlyLateReview.Fw-190D-9_Late_DZZMod: Local labels already distinguish 1944/1945 under D-9; retain year and weapon-mod distinction, no invented D-10 subtype.
earlyLateReview.Bf-109G-6_Late: Aircraft Guide pp318-320 distinguishes G-6 Late from G-6AS. No unique new subtype established; retain Late, not /AS or G-14.
earlyLateReview.Il-4_Late: Local slot and resource audit; historical community inventories searched. No exact numbered series/block established for this mod, so keep the descriptive Early/Late.
earlyLateReview.La-5F_Early: Local slot and resource audit; historical community inventories searched. No exact numbered series/block established for this mod, so keep the descriptive Early/Late.
earlyLateReview.Yak-1B_Early: Local slot and resource audit; historical community inventories searched. No exact numbered series/block established for this mod, so keep the descriptive Early/Late.
earlyLateReview.Yak-7B_late: Local slot and resource audit; historical community inventories searched. No exact numbered series/block established for this mod, so keep the descriptive Early/Late.
earlyLateReview.Yak-9M_Early: Local slot and resource audit; historical community inventories searched. No exact numbered series/block established for this mod, so keep the descriptive Early/Late.
earlyLateReview.Yak-9U_Early: Local slot and resource audit; historical community inventories searched. No exact numbered series/block established for this mod, so keep the descriptive Early/Late.
earlyLateReview.IAR80early: Class/FMD suffix A conflicts with mesh/OS1.1/SAS Early label; old dump registers four weapon hooks. Do not rename IAR 80A based on class token alone.
earlyLateReview.Bf-109E-1_Late: Conflict: local key/OS1.1 label say Late, class BF_109E1early and SAS inventory say Early, mesh/FMD reference E-4. Preserve local label; do not invent an official subtype.

unresolved.Bf-109G-10MG: MG mod suffix retained without expansion.
